spans.title: Stuck in the Railings
spans.blurb: A visitor arrives at a chaotic household to find a small boy wedged by the neck between iron railings, and everyone's rescue plan makes it worse.

spans.title: Luckily Met at Carnival
spans.blurb: At the height of carnival, a man in motley is flattered into abandoning the festivities to prove his palate against a rival's, whatever the cold vaults hold.

spans.title: Down Among the Bones
spans.blurb: Two friends descend by torchlight through bone-lined vaults in search of a rare wine, one coughing in the damp, the other oddly solicitous about turning back.
spans.spoilerNote: The trowel moment strongly telegraphs what the narrator plans for his companion in the vaults.

books.pairNote: The short is the carnival lure and the story is the descent that follows; contiguous scenes but no shared text and no shared payoff.

spans.title: The Corporal Drops His Hat
spans.blurb: News of a death reaches the kitchen, and a corporal's single gesture with his hat says more about mortality than any sermon.

spans.title: The Headless Ones
spans.blurb: From a hidden vantage, a traveler watches headless human bodies crawl and feed inside a walled enclosure, and slowly realizes this is their normal condition.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals the headless creatures the heroine discovers early in the book, though not what they truly are.

spans.title: Two Simple Words
spans.blurb: A broke young woman interviews for a suspiciously generous job in Paris, and a name plucked from memory turns her genial employer purple with rage.

spans.title: In the Name of the Law
spans.blurb: Three blows at the door interrupt a gathering, and a magistrate with soldiers asks which of the company answers to a certain name.

spans.title: A Most Violent Knocking
spans.blurb: A family round their fireside hears a thunderous knocking and must debate, at length and with great philosophy, whether anyone is actually at the door.

spans.title: The Mantle of Kings' Beards
spans.blurb: A messenger brings an outrageous demand: a rival king trims his mantle with the beards of conquered kings, and one place remains.

spans.title: The Kitchen Knight
spans.blurb: A damosel begs the court for a champion and storms off when the quest goes to a kitchen page. Then he starts unhorsing famous knights.

spans.title: The Siege of the Cellar
spans.blurb: A barricaded friend finally opens the cellar door, upright but swaying, having spent his siege drinking the innkeeper's stock down to the last cask.

spans.title: Four Against Five
spans.blurb: A young hothead must choose a side in seconds when three outnumbered swordsmen face the cardinal's guards, and the choice will cost blood.

spans.title: One of the Forty Ways
spans.blurb: A captive duke entertains his jailer by describing, step by step, exactly how a prisoner might escape, while a pie sits waiting on the table.
spans.spoilerNote: Shows that the duke's long-planned escape from the fortress succeeds.
